text: Merged (branch b0248b9). There is one token source in studio-app that generates JavaFX CSS, web CSS and Scala tokens. TokenContrastSuite is green in both themes. The NoLiteralColourLint (with self-test) is in checkBoundaries. The amendments are in DESIGN_SPEC §14. Follow-ups: extend the lint to named colours (done in the review round), and the figure control colour is resolved as #B86E0E.
